role.en: This late war Tank matched a Heavy 90mm gun with much stronger armor to produce an Allied Tank that could engage Enemy Panthers and Tigers

role.en: The Panther is one of the best Tanks in the war. Armed with a deadly 75mm main Gun and exceptional frontal armor, the Panther's only weakness is its rear and top armor.
